property_summary: For any input _val and initial MinSum, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the reference contract sets MinSum equal to exactly _val (overwrites previous value); the buggy mutant instead makes MinSum increase cumulatively (MinSum becomes MinSum + _val) and thus will differ for some fuzzed _val.
change_summary: Change assignment to add the provided value to MinSum instead of overwriting it, so calling SetMinSum increases the stored MinSum cumulatively.
